text: Proton Mail Privacy Policy. Proton is a Swiss privacy company. We do not sell your data to advertisers or anyone else. We do not use your emails to train AI or machine learning models. All emails are end-to-end encrypted — we cannot read their content. We retain only minimal metadata (sender, recipient, timestamps) required to deliver mail. When you delete your account, we permanently erase your personal data within 30 days. You retain all rights to your messages and content; we claim no license to them. We do not share data with any third-party marketers or data brokers.

Signal Privacy Policy. Signal messages and calls are end-to-end encrypted — not even Signal can read them. We do not sell, rent, trade, or monetize your personal information. We do not use your communications for AI or machine learning training. The only data Signal stores on its servers is your phone number (hashed) and the date you last connected. Contacts, group memberships, profile names, and avatars remain encrypted on your device. You own everything you send. Signal is funded by a nonprofit. There are no advertisers.

DuckDuckGo Privacy Policy. We do not track you. We do not store personal information. Search queries are never logged or linked to any identity. We do not use your searches to train AI or machine learning models. We do not sell or share data with advertisers, data brokers, or any third parties. The only data our services store are optional local settings on your device. Account deletion for DuckDuckGo Premium removes all personal data within 30 days. You retain ownership of everything you type.

Bitwarden Privacy Policy. Your vault is protected with zero-knowledge end-to-end encryption — we cannot see your passwords or vault contents. We do not sell or rent user data. We do not use your vault or usage data for AI training. We collect only essential account metadata (email, subscription status) to provide the service. Upon account deletion, all personal data is permanently removed within 30 days. You retain full ownership of your passwords and vault items; we claim no license over them. No advertisers, no data brokers.

Brave Browser Privacy Policy. Brave does not collect your browsing history, cookies, or personally identifiable data by default. Our servers never see which websites you visit. We do not sell any user data to third parties. We do not use browsing data to train AI models. Optional Brave Rewards activity is processed locally on your device. Sync data is end-to-end encrypted. Account data tied to Brave services is deleted within 30 days of closure. You own your browsing data completely.

Basecamp Privacy Policy. Basecamp is a small employee-owned company based in Chicago. We do not sell your data. We do not share your data with advertisers or data brokers. We do not use customer project content to train AI or machine learning systems. Personal data we collect is limited to what is needed to provide the service: your name, email address, billing details, and the content you create in Basecamp. Customer content and data is encrypted at rest and in transit. You retain all ownership rights to the content you upload — we do not claim any license beyond what is necessary to host and display your projects to your team. When you cancel your account, we delete all of your data within 30 days of cancellation. We publish a complete record of subprocessors on our website. We provide clear mechanisms to export your data at any time. Our policy is written in plain language and we encourage you to read it.

Notion Privacy Policy. Notion collects the information you provide when you create an account and the content you add to your workspaces. We use this information to operate the service, provide customer support, and improve our product. We do not sell personal data. We share data with third-party service providers (cloud hosting, analytics, payment processors) under contractual obligations that require them to protect your information. We may use aggregated, non-identifiable usage data to help improve Notion, including to explore new AI-powered features; you can opt out of your content being used to improve models in workspace settings. We retain your workspace content for as long as your account is active. When you delete your account, personal data and workspace content are deleted within 90 days, except where retention is required by law. You retain ownership of all content you create in Notion. We claim only a limited license to host and display your content. We notify users of material policy changes at least 30 days before they take effect.

Buffer Privacy Policy. Buffer is a social media management platform. We collect your name, email, and the social accounts you connect. We also collect posting data and analytics from connected social networks on your behalf. We use this data to provide the Buffer service. We do not sell your personal data. We share data with subprocessors (hosting, payment processing, analytics) under DPA agreements. We use anonymized aggregated data to improve our product. Buffer does not train AI models on your private posts or connected account content without opt-in. Connected social platforms have their own data practices which Buffer does not control. When you delete your Buffer account, your personal data and posting queue are removed within 60 days. You retain all rights to the content you create or schedule through Buffer. We send product update emails that you can unsubscribe from at any time. We publish a list of subprocessors and notify users of changes.

Doist Privacy Policy (Todoist and Twist). We collect account information (email, name), task content, and usage data. We use this data to provide the service and improve the app. We do not sell personal information. We share data with trusted subprocessors under data processing agreements. We use aggregated usage data to improve Todoist features. We do not use your task content to train AI models by default. Our servers are hosted in the EU and US with industry-standard encryption. When you delete your account, your tasks, projects, and personal data are permanently removed within 30 days. You retain ownership of the content in your tasks. We grant ourselves only a minimal license to store and sync your data across your devices. We do not share your task content with advertisers. Users receive notifications of material changes to this policy.

GitHub Privacy Statement. GitHub collects account registration information, content you push to repositories, activity data, and information necessary for billing. We process this data to operate the platform. GitHub does not sell your personal information. We share limited data with subprocessors (cloud providers, payment processors). Public repository content is, by its nature, publicly accessible. Private repository content is accessible only to collaborators you authorize. GitHub may use aggregated anonymized usage patterns to improve the service; Copilot training on public code is subject to its own terms and opt-outs. We retain account data for as long as your account is active; upon account deletion, personal data is removed within 90 days (public commits attributed to you may remain in forks and archives). You retain full ownership of the code and content you upload. GitHubs only license over your content is to provide and improve the service in accordance with your repository visibility settings.

Slack Privacy Policy. Slack is a workplace communications platform provided by Salesforce. We collect the information you provide when your organization creates a workspace (names, email addresses, profile photos), the content of messages and files you share, integrations you enable, and usage data such as timestamps, devices, and IP addresses. We use this data to operate the Slack service, provide customer support, invoice your organization, secure the service, and communicate about updates. Slack does not sell customer data. Slack processes customer data only under the instructions of the Customer (typically the employer organization). Customer administrators control access, exports, retention, and deletion. We use aggregated, de-identified usage data to improve the Slack product, including certain AI-powered features; customer content itself is not used to train generative AI models without the customers explicit consent. We share data with subprocessors providing hosting, email delivery, analytics, and customer support, all under contractual obligations. When a workspace is deleted, we remove customer data within 30 days subject to legal holds. Customers retain ownership of all content posted in their workspaces; Slack has only a limited license to host, display, and process the content as necessary to provide the service. We provide advance notice of material policy changes. We publish subprocessor lists, security compliance reports, and data processing addenda for enterprise customers.

Dropbox Privacy Policy. Dropbox is a file storage and collaboration service. We collect account information (name, email, billing), the files you upload, metadata about those files (name, size, type, modification time), sharing activity, and device and IP information. We use this data to operate the sync service, support collaboration, and protect against abuse. Dropbox does not sell your personal information to third parties. We use subprocessors for cloud infrastructure, customer support, and fraud prevention under contractual safeguards. We use aggregated non-identifiable usage metrics to improve the service. Dropbox does not train artificial intelligence models on the private contents of your files without opt-in; Dropbox AI features process files only when you invoke them and are subject to specific terms. We share limited data with business partners (such as Google Drive integrations, Office integrations) only when you enable them. Account deletion removes your files and personal data within 60 days, except where legal retention applies. You retain full ownership of the files you upload; Dropbox claims only a narrow worldwide license solely to host, sync, and share your files as you direct. Our Transparency Report discloses government data requests. We provide advance notification of material policy changes.

Zoom Privacy Statement. Zoom provides video communications services. We collect account registration data, meeting metadata (duration, participants, host), content customers provide (chat messages, shared files, recordings if enabled), device and network information, and billing data. Meeting host organizations control recording, transcription, AI features, and data retention for their accounts. We do not sell personal data in the way regulators define sale. We share data with subprocessors for hosting infrastructure, payment processing, customer support, and analytics under DPA agreements. Zoom has committed publicly that it does not use customer audio, video, chat, screen sharing, or attachments to train AI or machine learning models without customer consent; AI Companion features are opt-in at the account level. We share aggregated de-identified service performance data for product improvement. Meeting recordings, transcripts, chat, and whiteboards are retained according to the host organizations configured retention policy. Account deletion removes personal data within 30 days subject to legal holds. Customers retain ownership of their content; Zoom has only a limited license to transmit and store content as needed to deliver the service. We publish a Transparency Report, subprocessor list, and compliance certifications (SOC 2, ISO 27001).

Spotify Privacy Policy. Spotify collects account registration data (email, date of birth, country), listening history and preferences, playlist data, payment information, and device and network data. We use this data to personalize recommendations, operate the service, process payments, and deliver ads for Free-tier users. Spotify uses listening data and inferred preferences to show you personalized audio and display ads. For advertising, Spotify shares limited data such as hashed email addresses, device identifiers, and interest segments with advertising partners and marketing partners for targeting, measurement, and attribution. Users can adjust ad preferences in settings. We do not use your private playlists or uploaded podcast content to train generative AI models without your consent. We share data with subprocessors for hosting, payment processing, analytics, and customer support. Account deletion via the privacy center removes personal data within 90 days subject to legal retention obligations. Spotify does not claim ownership over podcasts you upload via Spotify for Podcasters — you grant a license to host and distribute them as you configure. Users in the EEA, UK, and California have extended rights under GDPR and CCPA, including the right to opt out of the sharing of personal data for targeted advertising.

Netflix Privacy Statement. Netflix collects account information (email, password, payment method), viewing history, search queries, device identifiers, approximate location, and interactions with the service. We use this data to provide, personalize, and recommend content, process subscriptions, prevent fraud, and deliver the service. Netflix does not sell personal information in the traditional sense. Netflix uses aggregated viewing data to inform content licensing and production decisions. Netflix may share limited data with advertising partners for the ad-supported tier — such as device identifiers and viewing categories — to deliver ads and measure performance. Users on ad-supported plans may adjust certain ad preferences. We share data with service providers handling payment processing, customer support, data analytics, and hosting, bound by contractual obligations. Netflix has publicly stated it does not use subscriber viewing data for external AI model training; internal recommendation models are considered part of the service. Account cancellation retains personal data for 10 months to allow easy reactivation; after that, personal data is deleted subject to legal obligations. Netflix does not claim ownership over user-generated reviews or profile content. Users have rights under applicable privacy laws (GDPR, CCPA) to access, delete, and correct their data.

Discord Privacy Policy. Discord collects account information (username, email, password), profile information, messages sent in servers and direct messages, voice and video data processed for communications, friend lists, server memberships, and device and network data. Server admins control their own servers rules and data. Discord uses this data to operate the service, moderate safety violations, support customer requests, and personalize features. Discord does not sell personal data. Discord has publicly committed that it does not use the content of user messages to train third-party AI models; internal AI features for moderation use message content only in anonymized or policy-violation contexts. Discord shares data with subprocessors for cloud hosting, voice and video infrastructure, payment processing, and support. Discord displays ads on some surfaces and uses limited ad partner data sharing for promoted servers and Nitro upsell. Account deletion permanently removes personal data within 30 days, although anonymized server message history may remain in server archives owned by server operators. Users retain the copyright in their content and grant Discord a non-exclusive license to host, display, and relay messages for service operation. Discord publishes transparency reports on law enforcement requests.

Twitch Privacy Notice. Twitch is an interactive live streaming service owned by Amazon. We collect account information (username, email, age), profile data, streaming and viewing data, chat messages, subscriptions and Bits purchases, and device information. Twitch uses this data to operate the streaming platform, pay creators, moderate safety, deliver personalized recommendations, and show advertising. Twitch participates in Amazons advertising ecosystem — this means Twitch may share device identifiers, viewing and chat interest signals, and hashed account identifiers with Amazon Advertising and select advertising partners for targeted advertising, frequency capping, and measurement. Users can opt out of certain personalized advertising in account settings or via Amazons ad preferences. Twitch does not use your private messages or whispers to train external AI models. We share data with subprocessors for hosting, video transcoding, payment processing, and content moderation. Stream recordings (VODs) are retained according to your account plan and can be deleted by you at any time. Account deletion removes personal data within 90 days subject to legal holds. Creators retain ownership of their streams; Twitch holds a non-exclusive license to transmit, cache, and display streams as needed to operate the platform.

Reddit Privacy Policy. Reddit collects the information you provide when you register (username — email is optional for some accounts), posts and comments you submit, votes and saves, subreddits you subscribe to, device identifiers, and approximate location. Reddit is, by design, a largely public platform — most posts and comments are publicly accessible. Reddit uses this data to operate the service, personalize recommendations, deliver advertising, enforce content policies, and improve the product. Reddit monetizes content through advertising and data licensing — Reddit has publicly announced data licensing arrangements with AI companies (such as training data licensing to Google and other AI model providers) where Reddit content is used to train large language models. User posts on public subreddits are considered public content under these arrangements. Reddit displays personalized ads and shares limited data (approximate location, device identifiers, interest categories) with advertising partners. Users can opt out of personalized advertising in their account settings. Account deletion removes the account association but posts and comments you made may remain visible (attributed to deleted) on public subreddits because they are part of the shared public conversation. Users retain copyright over their content; Reddit claims a broad, non-exclusive, royalty-free, worldwide license to host, display, reformat, and license your content to third parties for any purpose. Users in the EEA, UK, and California have additional rights.

LinkedIn Privacy Policy. LinkedIn is a professional networking platform owned by Microsoft. We collect registration data (name, email, employment history), profile content, network connections, messages, activity and engagement data, device and network information, and inferred professional interests and seniority. LinkedIn uses this data to operate the network, deliver recommendations, run advertising, recruit candidates on behalf of employers, and sell Sales Navigator and Recruiter Lite targeting segments. LinkedIn shares extensive user data with advertisers and marketing partners: including hashed email addresses, job titles, company sizes, industries, seniority levels, and inferred skills — this data is used by third-party advertisers for account-based marketing, lookalike audiences, and retargeting across the LinkedIn platform and partner networks. LinkedIn has publicly disclosed it uses member data (excluding private messages) to train generative AI features; opt-out is available in privacy settings but is enabled by default globally outside a few privileged jurisdictions. LinkedIn shares data with Microsoft affiliates. Account closure retains data for 14 days for reactivation, then personal data is deleted; however posts and comments made in public groups may remain visible attributed to LinkedIn Member. LinkedIn claims a worldwide, transferable, sublicensable license to use your content for its services, including advertising and AI model training where applicable.

Pinterest Privacy Policy. Pinterest is a visual discovery service. We collect account registration data (email, full name if provided), pins you save and search, boards you create, inferred interests, device identifiers, and approximate location. Pinterest uses this data to personalize recommendations, show contextual and personalized ads, and operate the service. Pinterest shares limited advertising signals with partners — including hashed email addresses, device identifiers, and interest categories — for ad targeting, measurement, and conversion tracking through the Pinterest Ads Platform and related programs with marketing partners. Users can manage ad personalization in settings. Pinterest does not sell personal information in the strict CCPA sense but does share advertising data under consumer opt-out obligations. Pinterest does not use private boards or direct messages to train generative AI models; image recognition and recommendation models use public pins. We share data with subprocessors (hosting, payment processing, content moderation, analytics) under contractual commitments. Account deletion removes personal data within 90 days subject to legal retention. You retain rights in the original content you create or upload; Pinterest claims a non-exclusive, royalty-free, transferable license to use pinned content in connection with the Pinterest services. Users in the EEA, UK, and California have additional rights under applicable laws.
